newsitem.title: USA: First Merchants in default of loan pact.
newsitem.headline: First Merchants in default of loan pact.

text.p: First Merchants Acceptance Corp, a specialty finance firm, said Tuesday it is in default under its secured senior loan agreement with its banks and may seek protection under the United States Bankruptcy Code.
First Merchants also said it has not been able to obtain replacement financing for its senior loan facility and that its bank group has ceased honoring checks.
The company continues to explore other sources of financing, but may seek protection under the United States Bankruptcy Code, First Merchants said in a news release.
First Merchants had reported in April 8 that it discovered certain irregularities involving unauthorized entries made in the company's financial records that violated its financing arrangements.
Later in April, First Merchants hired Salomon Brothers to help identify financing options and alternatives for the company.
First Merchants provides financing for the purchase of used automobiles by consumers who have limited access to traditional sources of credit.
Shares of First Merchants were trading off one to 3-1/8 after a halt in trading pending an announcement.
